profile.name: Victor Decha Zhevanya
profile.headline: Creative Strategist | Creative Producer | Director
profile.bio: I began in Veterinary Medicine, where I learned to think critically, solve problems through research, and observe with intention. Today, I craft content strategies, lead creative productions, direct music videos, and build brand experiences by connecting People, Story, and Purpose. Every creative decision serves a purpose: making people feel something.

releases.title: HITAM : Official Music Video
releases.summary: Directing Makatita’s official music video through a White Supper concept, with one production day across Blok M and the studio.
releases.objective: Create a visually distinctive music video within a compressed timeline while translating an emotionally complex song into a cinematic experience.
releases.insight: HITAM means black, but the emotional journey was about what lay beneath it: silence, guilt, vulnerability, and emotional conflict.
releases.concept: White Supper uses contrast, symbolism, and emotion instead of portraying darkness literally.
releases.execution: June 1 creative brief; June 26 production, from 1–4 AM in Blok M and 9 AM–9 PM in the studio; July 8 release.
releases.outcome: Vico’s first official music video. The project reinforced preparation, adaptability, creative leadership, and trust across the team.

releases.title: KITE Talent Reveal Project
releases.summary: Six distinct stories introducing KITE Entertainment talents, developed over 1.5 years with production scales ranging from small crews to a mini docu-drama.
releases.objective: Introduce who each new talent is, and why audiences should care, through stories that feel uniquely theirs.
releases.insight: Different personalities, backgrounds, and ambitions need different ways of being seen.
releases.concept: Build persona insights and a shared guideline before translating each talent’s identity into narrative direction, visual language, references, and a production approach.
releases.execution: Projects 01–05 used 5–10 crew and IDR 5–15M budgets. Max Huang’s production involved 20+ crew, a Rp200M+ budget, six months of development, and a three-day shoot.
releases.outcome: Six talents introduced through individual stories. Each reveal informed a creative system that continued to evolve.

releases.title: Sitha Marino : Branded Storytelling Engine
releases.summary: End-to-end creative strategy and production for Sitha Marino’s TikTok and Instagram brand collaborations.
releases.objective: Bridge business objectives, creator authenticity, and production execution into one shared creative process.
releases.insight: Authenticity starts with understanding the creator: communication style, content formats, editing rhythm, humor, and audience expectations.
releases.concept: Adapt each campaign to Sitha’s voice instead of adapting the creator to fit a corporate brief.
releases.execution: Brief analysis, concepts, storyline, scheduling, talent coordination, on-set direction, brand compliance, post-production, approvals, publishing, and performance review.
releases.outcome: Approval cycles accelerated after the first few months. Audience response, brand feedback, and talent feedback informed subsequent campaigns.
